preconditions: All locally registered runner peers must independently verify their configured interpreter, the pinned Core 0.6.0 payload, clean shared code and idle explicit node queues. Legacy jobs/workers and the first private Core upgrade/queue initialization are handled separately by the owner; missing or unknown state is not idle. Hold all node admission gates and update shared code once. Never use public GitHub or push. Bind each node receipt to alias/project/target/policy/bundle and its own expected and observed environment. Keep failed attempts and historical credentials; no automatic retries or queue/cache migration.
readBack: From the registered project working directory run E:/conda_package/envs/gnn/python.exe -B scripts/syncmate/install.py receipt --node gpu4090 and E:/conda_package/envs/gnn/python.exe -B scripts/syncmate/install.py receipt --node gpu4090-2, stopping if either fails. Both node-specific receipts must independently validate this landed target, alias, shared project, policy, bundle and expected/observed Core/interpreter environment. Current per-node receipt.json files remain execution credentials while their target is valid. Preserve failed attempt-*.json for diagnosis; the Closeout owner archives necessary evidence and cleans only superseded receipts/attempts after they no longer authorize execution. Temporary code bundles are removed by the installer; persistent runner-install-<node>.log files are preserved. See scripts/syncmate/README.md for exact locations and the separately authorized first Core transition.
